title: [Need help]Synchronizing User Data in RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: JoshuaLam
posts.body:
I am currently developing a game using RPG Maker MZ and I have a few questions regarding user data synchronization.
How can I load the data into a new game during updates?
I am considering adding a registration and login system to ensure that users can sync their data from the server after logging in, as I want to prevent any loss of their progress. What would be the best approach to accomplish this? I am struglling the file system of the game, e.g. global.rmmzsave and config.rmmzsave, and the functions in rmmz_managers.js.
I deployed my game on itch.io, but I am unsure how to update the browser's database using localforage. Let say the data can be received from a database like AWS. The process should be User registration, User login, fetch save file from the server, save file creation and uploading(I tried to override the default savegame function but I messed them up :<). Any guidance on this would be greatly appreciated.
Thank you for taking the time to read my questions. I truly appreciate any insights or suggestions you may have!
